1024.note: the per-rank batch each term is computed on

4096.note: the union across four ranks, i.e. what the DDP mean covers

gate6_rule: the issue asks >=95% of sampled batches to carry at least one high and one low edge; at the per-rank 1024 it is 62.5% (low-AF3 edges are bursty: 0..105 per batch), at the global 4096 the gradient mean covers 100%. Both are recorded; the verdict uses the union the DDP mean actually averages.
